title: Menubar
description: The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): menus that open from a bar and behave like Menu.
when: Editors and tool apps with many commands (3D, slicer, image tools), next to an AppHeader.
a11y: role="menubar": ←/→ move between menus (and switch the open one), ↓ / Enter open, Escape closes and returns focus; one tab stop for the bar.
